/subscribed/subtitle.v: Hlola ibhokisi lakho lokungenayo ukuze uthole i-imeyili yokuqinisekisa.

/form/intro.v: Ushicilelo olusha lufika nge-imeyili, lubhalwe ngolimi olukhethayo.

/form/nameHint.v: Silisebenzisa ukukubingelela. Uma ulishiya lingenalutho, sisebenzisa ingxenye yokuqala yekheli lakho le-imeyili.

/form/consent.v: Ngokubhalisa, uyavuma ukuthola ama-imeyili avela ku-{sender}. I-imeyili ngayinye inesixhumanisi sokuyeka ukubhalisa.

/success/body.v: Sithumele i-imeyili yokuqinisekisa ku-{email}. Yivule bese ukhetha Qinisekisa ukubhalisa.

/success/next.v: Ushicilelo lwakho lokuqala lufika ngemva kokuthi uqinisekise, lubhalwe nge-{language}.

/success/spam.v: Uma kungafiki lutho emizuzwini embalwa, bheka kufolda ye-spam noma ye-Promotions.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Leli kheli le-imeyili libonakala lingaphelele. Lihlole bese uzama futhi.

/errors/missingLink.v: Lesi sixhumanisi sokubhalisa asinalo lonke ulwazi. Cela isixhumanisi esisha kumthumeli.

/errors/notFound.v: Lesi sixhumanisi sokubhalisa asisasebenzi. Cela isixhumanisi esisha kumthumeli.

/errors/limit.v: Leli phephandaba alikwazi ukwamukela ababhalisile abasha okwamanje. Zama futhi kamuva.

/errors/invalid.v: Asikwazanga ukwamukela leli kheli. Lihlole bese uzama futhi.

/errors/server.v: Asikwazanga ukulondoloza ukubhalisa kwakho. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhashana.

/errors/network.v: Asikwazanga ukufinyelela iseva. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.

/confirm/body.v: Khetha inkinobho ukuze uqale ukuthola ushicilelo ku-{email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Ngokuqinisekisa, uyavuma ukuthola leli phephandaba nge-imeyili. Ungayeka ukubhalisa kunoma yiluphi ushicilelo.

/confirm/successTip.v: Ukuze lungangeni ku-spam, engeza umthumeli koxhumana nabo.

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Vula futhi i-imeyili yokuqinisekisa bese ukhetha inkinobho yayo. Uma ungayitholi, bhalisa futhi ekhasini lomthumeli.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Asikutholanga ukubhalisa kwaleli kheli. Bhalisa futhi ekhasini lomthumeli.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa kwakho. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhashana.

/embed/intro.v: Namathisela enye yalezi zingcezu zekhodi kuwebhusayithi yakho. Abantu ababhalisayo bathola i-imeyili yokuqinisekisa, bese bethola ushicilelo lwakho ngolimi lwabo.

/embed/linkHint.v: Yabelana ngaso ku-bio yezokuxhumana, esiginesheni ye-imeyili, noma kukhodi ye-QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Yinamathisele lapho ifomu kufanele livele khona. Ifomu lizilungisela usayizi ngokwalo.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Sebenzisa lokhu uma isayithi yakho ingavumeli ama-script.

/embed/accentHint.v: Yishiye injalo ukuze usebenzise umbala womkhiqizo wakho.

/embed/previewNote.v: Lokhu kubuka kuqala kuyasebenza ngempela. Ukubhalisa lapha kudala obhalisile wangempela.

/embed/missing.v: Qala ngokudala iphephandaba. Ifomu lokubhalisa lizovela lapha uma selikhona.

/signature/intro.v: Abafundi babona lokhu ekugcineni koshicilelo ngalunye. Chofoza noma iyiphi ingxenye yokubuka kuqala ukuze uyihlele.

/signature/showHint.v: Uma uyicisha, ushicilelo luphela ngemva kwendatshana.

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Isiginesha yakho ayinalutho. Engeza igama lakho ukuze uqale.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Khetha ithegi ukuze ubonise noma ufihle leyo ngxenye. Izingxenye ezifihliwe zigcina umbhalo wazo.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Isixhumanisi se-PNG noma i-JPG eyisikwele, okungenani ama-pixel angu-144 x 144 futhi ngaphansi kuka-200 KB. Kuboniswa ngama-pixel angu-72 x 72 eduze kwegama lakho.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Isixhumanisi se-PNG noma i-JPG enengemuva elibonakalisayo noma elimhlophe, okungenani ama-pixel angu-64 ubude. Kuboniswa ngobude bama-pixel angu-32.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Kudingeka kokubili umbhalo nesixhumanisi ukuze inkinobho ivele.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Umbhalo omncane phansi, isibonelo inothi lobumfihlo. Yishiye ingenalutho uma ungayidingi.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Usetshenziselwa ibha, izixhumanisi nenkinobho. Uqala ngombala womkhiqizo wakho.

/signature/resetConfirm.v: Khetha futhi ukuze usule zonke izinkambu
